contents: What S7040P is and where it fits

slides.title: S7040P at a Glance
slides.lead: A dedicated PIN insertion machine on the S7020 platform: 4 insertion heads and 4 feeders insert up to 4 different pins in one pass, with CCD correction and insertion check on every point.
apps: Round pins and tape pins 1.2–4.0 mm, press-fit pins, PIN headers
Power supplies, appliance control boards, automotive and LED electronics
Vibration bowl for bulk pins or reel feeder for taped pins, per part
slides.caption: S7040P line with PCB loader and unloader
slides.notes: Platform and outline per S7020T. Pin range 1.2–4.0 mm: S-7000P Pin Inserter literature. Photo: real S7020T installation, model label changed to S7040P (same outline) — do not caption as an S7040P customer site.

slides.title: Why Manual Pin Insertion Holds Lines Back
slides.lead: Pins are small, sharp and press-fit. Hand insertion caps output and quality long before soldering.
items: Operators press pin after pin; speed drops over the shift
Found only at test or after soldering, then reworked
Uneven hand force stresses plating and PCB
Each pin type needs its own station or changeover
Output follows headcount and staff turnover
No record of what was inserted, when and by whom
slides.notes: Qualitative customer pains, Southern Machinery brand voice. No figures claimed.

slides.title: Key Figures
slides.lead: S7040P = S7020T platform with 4 insertion heads and 4 feeders, dedicated to PIN insertion.
items: Up to 4 pin types, no changeover
slides.footer: 7,200 parts/h = 3,600 s ÷ 0.5 s, insertion only; PCB in/out and Mark reading are added per board.
slides.notes: AGENTS.md v2 (Jason, 2026-11-07); S7020 Series 202303; S7020T manual. Speed 0.5 s/part is the unified figure (Jason). 0.015 mm automatic correction: S7020T manual.

slides.title: FAB 1 · Four Heads, Four Feeders
slides.notes: Insertion angle 360° increment 1°: S7020 Series 202303. Feeders bowl or reel: Jason 2026-11-07.

slides.title: FAB 2 · Accuracy, Checks and Data
slides.notes: Miss detection: machine stops and reports an error, re-insertion settable. Programming: online visual programming, visual correction, EXCEL; USB import; RS-232C MES.
